relationships.subject: nab-paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: The expressions of ZO-1, claudin-5, and occludin-1 were decreased in the nab-P group (P=0.002, P=0.004, and P=0.005, respectively) in comparison with the control group.

relationships.subject: TPPU
relationships.evidence_quote: sEH inhibition by TPPU significantly upregulated the expression of ZO-1, claudin-5 and occludin-1 compared to the nab-P group

relationships.subject: TPPU
relationships.evidence_quote: TPPU reversed the protein levels of sEH, NF-κB, and downstream inflammatory cytokines and oxidative stress levels which promoted by nab-paclitaxel

relationships.subject: TPPU
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared to the nab-P group, the levels of TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6 were reduced, and the levels of IL-4 and IL-10 were elevated in the nab-P + TPPU group

relationships.subject: TPPU
relationships.evidence_quote: For the first time, we demonstrated that sEH inhibition with TPPU alleviates mechanical and thermal pain in a model of nab-paclitaxel-induced neuropathic pain.

key_findings: sEH inhibitor TPPU alleviated nab-paclitaxel neuropathic pain and protected BSCB integrity via tight junction proteins
TPPU suppressed sEH/NF-kB signalling, cytokines and oxidative stress in rat spinal cord
